test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word(s) in the given sentence.

Monik said that it is mandatory that __each student pay__ his/her tuition fees every month.
solution:
The correct answer is: **each student pays**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is "**each student**," which is **singular **and requires a **singular verb**.
 
• The correct singular form of the verb "pay" in the present tense is "**pays**."
 
• The construction "**it is mandatory that**" indicates a general rule or obligation, hence the present tense verb "**pays**" is appropriate.
 
• Other options do not fit the grammatical context:
 
 
• **Paids**: Incorrect because "paids" is not a valid form of the verb "pay."
 
• **Paid**: Incorrect as it is the past tense form and does not fit the present obligation context.
 
• **Students pay**: Incorrect because "each student" is singular, not plural.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Monik said that it is mandatory that **each student pays**__ his/her tuition fees every month."*
